column1: # agentctl's DESIGN RULES TABLE (quality/design.py reads it; CLAUDE.md, "Design"): the movies repository's rules for
# every language, stated once. The limits, suffixes, abbreviations and idioms below are the movies table's own rows,
# copied (tests/test_design_rules.py fails when they differ from ~/projects/movies/test/resources/design-rules.tsv,
# where that checkout exists); the adapters, distance rows and layers after them are agentctl's. Loosening a row -- a
# limit raised, an adapter or an allowed idiom added, a layer moved up -- lands only with the kind's trailer
#   suffix<TAB><word>                                   a name may not END in it
#   abbreviation<TAB><word>                             a word of a name that is an abbreviation of a real word
#   idiom<TAB><word>                                    a language-standard idiom, allowed although it abbreviates
#   adapter<TAB><language><TAB><module><TAB><effects>    a module allowed to touch these effects directly (clock,
#                                                       process, env): every other module receives them
#   distance<TAB><language><TAB><directory>             a directory whose distance D is measured
#   layer<TAB><language><TAB><directory><TAB><rank><TAB><why>   a directory's rank, bottom (0) up: a module may import
#                                                       only from its own rank or a lower one

# The idioms allowed (the owner, 2026-11-26): `args`, `kwargs`, `self`, `e` for events, `i`/`j` loop indexes, `ctx` only
